question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：西班牙 vs 沙特阿拉伯（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group H: Spain vs Saudi Arabia (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: Elo 第 1 对第 69 的 581 分差距让西班牙胜成为压倒性基准，沙特换帅动荡难以撼动，仅因西班牙核心伤愈节奏与沙特防守韧性小幅下调约 2 个百分点。
one_liner_en: The 581-point Elo gap between No. 1 Spain and No. 69 Saudi Arabia makes a Spain win the overwhelming baseline; only Spain's returning-player rhythm and Saudi defensive resilience warrant a ~2pp trim.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：西班牙 2157（世界第 1）对沙特 1576（第 69），Davidson 模型基准即给出西班牙约 86% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Spain 2157 (world No. 1) vs Saudi Arabia 1576 (No. 69); the Davidson baseline already gives Spain about 86%.

key_reasons.cn: 西班牙伤情小幅不确定：Fermín López 缺席，Yamal 自 4 月 22 日后未出场、首战或限时；本场为第二轮，可用性应更高。
key_reasons.en: Mild Spain injury uncertainty: Fermín López out; Yamal has not played since April 22 and may be minute-limited early — this is matchday 2, so availability should improve.

key_reasons.cn: 沙特 4 月 17 日临阵换帅（Donis 仅带队 3 场），但 6 月 9 日 0-0 平塞内加尔显示低位防守仍有韧性。
key_reasons.en: Saudi Arabia changed coach on April 17 (Donis has only 3 matches in charge), yet the 0-0 draw with Senegal on June 9 shows a resilient low block.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 85.7/11.3/3.0; bounded evidence adjustment (~2.1pp total, cap +/-8pp) -> p_final 84.0/12.6/3.4; 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus thin pre-tournament evidence. No betting/prediction-market data used.
